title: Find a pair in one pass
prompt: Return the two positions [i, j], with i less than j, whose numbers add up to target. Return undefined when there is no such pair. The tests have at most one pair. Make one pass: the last check counts the reads on 2,000 numbers.
hints: When you are at a number, which other number would complete the pair?
Keep a Map from each number already seen to its position. Look up target minus the current number.
For each index: if the Map has target - value, return [that position, index]. Otherwise store value with its index.
checkLabels: 3 may not be used twice. 2 and 4 are at positions 1 and 2.
Two equal numbers at different positions count.
Do not try every pair. Read each of the 2,000 numbers only a few times.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Lets a number be paired with itself.
Tries every pair, which is correct and far too slow.

feedback: At each number, ask the Map one question: have I already seen the number that completes this pair?
